entries.name: Thingyan (Water Festival and Burmese New Year)
entries.capsule: Burmese New Year water festival in mid-April; the Chisago City temple calls it its biggest festival, with music, dance and food.
entries.dateRule: Mid-April, set each year from the traditional Myanmar lunisolar calendar by Myanmar's calendar board; usually about four water days before New Year's Day. Minnesota gatherings fall on a nearby weekend in April or May.

dates.source: Calculated with python-holidays (Myanmar), not confirmed by an opened page; New York resolution gives April 13-16 as typical

entries.whatItMarks: The passage from the old year to the new in the Myanmar calendar; water is thrown to wash away bad luck, and elders and monks are honored.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Sitagu Dhamma Vihara in Chisago City describes its Water Festival as generally the biggest Burmese festival of the year, in April or May, with Burmese folk music and dancing rehearsed for weeks, costumes, food, getting wet, and a chance to pay respects to the monks; it says the festival is not religious and sometimes includes Karen folk culture. No dated 2026 Minnesota event was found.

entries.name: Full Moon of Kasone (Buddha Day)
entries.capsule: Full moon of Kasone honoring the Buddha's birth, awakening and death; the Minnesota Burmese temple society was founded on it in 2004.
entries.dateRule: Full moon of the Myanmar month of Kasone, usually April or May. The Myanmar date can differ by a month from the Thai date in some years; the seed's Thai dates were replaced with Myanmar calculations.

entries.whatItMarks: The birth, enlightenment and passing of the Buddha in Theravada tradition.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: The society behind Sitagu Dhamma Vihara was founded on May 2, 2004, which its history calls the Kasone full moon Buddha Day. No dated Minnesota observance for 2026 was found.

entries.name: Waso Full Moon and Robe Offering (start of Buddhist Lent)
entries.capsule: Start of the monks' three-month rains retreat; the Chisago City temple holds a robe offering shortly after the July full moon.
entries.dateRule: Full moon of the Myanmar month of Waso, usually July; the temple's robe offering follows shortly after.

entries.capsule: A February day and night of making and judging sticky rice, a Burmese festival held at the Chisago City temple.
entries.dateRule: Traditionally at the full moon of the Myanmar month of Tabodwe; the Minnesota temple says generally in February, on a date it sets.

entries.name: Karenni DeeKu Festival
entries.capsule: Karenni festival of freedom and unity named for sticky rice in bamboo leaves; held in St. Paul each September.
entries.dateRule: A September weekend chosen each year by the Karenni Community of Minnesota.

entries.whatItMarks: A Karenni victory over Yuan invaders, and unity, symbolized by DeeKu tied in bundles of three.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Held in St. Paul by the Karenni Community of Minnesota. In 2024 (Sept. 21-22) it included a youth cultural dance, young singers and DeeKu at Community School of Excellence, then volleyball and youth soccer at West Minnehaha Recreation Center and a small fundraiser. 2026 was Sept. 19-20.

entries.whatItMarks: The military's seizure of power on Feb. 1, 2021 and the civil war that followed.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: In 2021, Minnesotans from Burma rallied at the State Capitol on Feb. 28 and March 13, the second organized by people of multiple Myanmar ethnic groups. Minnesota's Fourth District U.S. representative co-launched the Congressional Burma Caucus on the third anniversary, Feb. 1, 2024. No yearly Minnesota gathering on the date was found.
